desc: Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in designing, manufacturing, and exporting advanced technology systems. The Company operates in two segments: Defence Systems and Space Systems. The Defence Systems segment specializes in technology for weapon systems optimization and integration, as well as Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) and C4 systems for land warfare. The Company's key products include remote weapon systems, vehicle turrets, high-energy laser weapons (directed energy), as well as fully integrated and modular counter-UAS and C4 systems. The Space Systems segment specializes in applying EOS-developed optical sensors and effectors to detect, track and characterize objects in space. It includes capabilities in the domain of space control.

name: Elsight Ltd
desc: Elsight limited is engaged in providing ground-breaking hybrid (on-the-move or fixed) video/ data capturing, recording and transmission for various real- tactical security and surveillance purposes/applications. Its products include wearable and portable devices, vehicle mounted and fixed/wall mounted devices, including RiderM-04 mobile digital video recorder (DVR), command and control software, and multichannel-secure multi data link unit. RiderM-04 DVR offers encoding resolution (WD1) on all four channels (for transmission or recording), Wi-Fi automatic off load of recorded files, storage hard-disk shock vibration proof, two-way audio in between the command and control center and the vehicle where it is installed. Multichannel-secure multi data link unit is a technology, providing live video and audio transmission as well as recording capabilities through multiple 3G and 4G networks. Its solutions include first responders, intelligence, media and broadcast, telemedicine and transit.

name: Helia Group Ltd
desc: Helia Group Limited is a provider of Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI). It also provides tailored risk and capital management solutions. Its LMI proposition protects lenders if a homeowner defaults on a home loan and the lender is unable to recover the outstanding loan amount from the sale of the secured property. Lender's purchase LMI for risk transfer and capital management purposes. LMI provides protection to a lender to help borrowers purchase a property with a smaller deposit. LMI protects the lender against the risk of potential losses in case they are unable to make home loan repayments, and the lender is unable to recover the outstanding loan amount from the sale of security property. This makes loans more accessible to people who are looking to buy a home for less than a 20% deposit. Home buyers have a range of flexible options for paying the LMI cost to their lender. It also offers flexible solutions to support homeownership and provide options for covering the LMI cost.

name: Develop Global Ltd
desc: Develop Global Ltd is engaged in exploration and development of base metals and mining services. The Company is also involved in operations of its underground mining services division Develop Mining Services. Its segments include mining services and mining and exploration. Its projects include Sulphur Springs Project, Woodlawn Project, and Pioneer Dome. Its joint venture projects include Whim Creek Joint Venture, Balagundi Gold Project, Larkinville Gold Project, Blair-Golden Ridge Nickel, Wattle Dam Nickel, and Kangan Gold Project. The Sulphur Springs project is located approximately 144 kilometers (km) to the southeast of Port Hedland and includes the Sulphur Springs and Kangaroo Caves deposits together with tenements along the 27 km Panorama Trend that contains over six advanced targets that have returned intersections of commercial grade copper and zinc. The Woodlawn Project is a zinc-copper-lead-gold-silver project located in the Lachlan Fold belt in New South Wales.

name: Champion Iron Ltd
desc: Champion Iron Limited is an Australia-based iron ore exploration and development company. The Company through its wholly owned subsidiary, Quebec Iron Ore Inc., owns and operates the Bloom Lake Mining Complex, located on the south end of the Labrador Trough, approximately 13 kilometers (km) north of Fermont, Quebec. Bloom Lake is an open-pit operation with two concentration plants that primarily source energy from renewable hydroelectric power. It ships iron ore concentrate from Bloom Lake by rail, to a ship loading port in Sept-lles, Quebec, and has sold its iron ore concentrate to customers globally, including in China, Japan, the Middle East, Europe, South Korea, India and Canada. In addition to Bloom Lake, it owns a portfolio of exploration and development projects in the Labrador Trough, including the Kamistiatusset Project, located over 21 km south-east of Bloom Lake, and the Cluster II portfolio of properties. Its other projects are Cluster I, Powderhorn and Gullbridge projects.

name: Minerals 260 Ltd
desc: Minerals 260 Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company's projects include the Moora Project, Aston Project, and Bullabulling Project. The 100%-owned Moora Project is located 140km north-east of Perth in the Wheatbelt Region of Western Australia. The Moora Project consists of three granted exploration licenses and one exploration license application registered in the name of the Company’s subsidiary, ERL (Aust) Pty Ltd, covering approximately 371 sq km. The Aston Project is located in the Gascoyne Region of Western Australia, approximately 850 km north of Perth and 100 km northeast of the township of Gascoyne Junction. The Aston Project consists of 15 granted exploration licenses and two exploration license applications. The Bullabulling Project is an undeveloped gold deposit, located 25km south-west of Coolgardie in the Western Australian Goldfields. Its subsidiaries include ERL (Aust) Pty Ltd and Minerals 260 Holdings Pty Ltd.

name: Ora Banda Mining Ltd
desc: Ora Banda Mining Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in mining operations and the sale of gold, mine development and exploration in Western Australia. The Company is the 100% owner of the Davyhurst Gold Project, which is located approximately 120 kilometers (kms) north-west of Kalgoorlie, within the Tier one gold mining province of the Eastern Goldfields. The Davyhurst Gold Project includes approximately 67 granted tenements that cover an area of 1,135 square kilometers (km2). The Company's projects include Central Davyhurst, Riverina-Mulline, Siberia, Callion and Walhalla. Its Central Davyhurst project area is located within a five kms radius of the Davyhurst Processing Plant. The Company's Riverina Underground gold deposits are hosted within three separate shear/mylonite zones, namely Reggie’s, Murchison, and Main Lode, all trending approximately north-south. The Company's Sand King (Siberia) is an underground mine at the Davyhurst Gold Project.

name: Centuria Capital Group
desc: Centuria Capital Group is an Australia-based specialist investment manager. The Company delivers a range of products and services to investors, advisers and security holders. The Company offers a range of investment opportunities, including listed and unlisted real estate funds as well as tax-effective investment bonds. Its principal activities are the marketing and management of investment products including property investment funds and friendly society investment bonds, as well as co-investments in property investment funds. Its segments include Property funds management, Co-investments, Developments, Property and development finance, Investment bonds management and Corporate. Property Funds Management segment is engaged in the management of listed and unlisted property funds. Developments segment manages development projects and completion of structured property developments, which span sectors ranging from commercial office, industrial, health through to residential mixed use.

name: Orora Ltd
desc: Orora Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the design, manufacture and decoration of glass bottles and aluminum cans. The Company operates through two segments: Global Glass and Orora Cans. The Global Glass segment, with operations spanning across Australasia, Europe, North America and the UAE, manufactures and provides glass packaging solutions. This segment produces a spectrum of glass packaging ranging from the manufacture, customization and decoration of glass bottles for the premium and ultra-premium spirit and wine markets to standard bottles. The Orora Cans segment, with manufacturing sites located across Australia and New Zealand, provides customers across the Asia-Pacific region with aluminum can solutions across the beverage sector. This segment offers a varied range of aluminum can styles and sizes as well as custom printing and decoration. It produces cans of all shapes and sizes for customers across carbonated soft drinks, beer, cider and others.

name: Smartgroup Corporation Ltd
desc: Smartgroup Corporation Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in providing outsourced administration, fleet management, and software, distribution, and group services. The Company operates through three segments: Outsourced administration (OA), Vehicle services (VS), and Software, distribution, and group services (SDGS). The OA segment provides outsourced salary packaging services, novated leasing and associated products, and outsourced payroll services. The VS segment provides end-to-end fleet management services. The SDGS segment provides salary packaging software solutions, the marketing of salary packaging debit cards, distribution of vehicle insurance and workforce management software to the healthcare industry. The Company operates through a portfolio of brands including Smartsalary, Smartleasing, Smartfleet, Smartsalary Payroll Solutions, Autopia, Advantage Salary Packaging, AccessPay, PBI Solutions and Health-e Workforce Solutions.

name: Superloop Ltd
desc: Superloop Limited is an Australia-based telecommunications company. The Company operates through three segments: Wholesale, Business and Consumer. The Wholesale segment is defined by large scale telecommunications, data and technology customers who purchase various connectivity services to support their core business services, as well as retail Internet service providers who do not have access to a connectivity network of their own. Its products include NBN Access, NBN Enterprise Ethernet, Internet Access & IP Transit, Dark Fiber, Fixed Wireless Access, International Ethernet and others. The Business segment is defined by small, medium and large corporate customers who purchase connectivity services to facilitate their core business. Its products include NBN TC2 and Enterprise Ethernet, Fixed Wireless Access, VoIP and Managed Wi-Fi. and others. The Consumer segment is defined by customers who purchase basic Internet and mobile phone products for domestic residential use.

name: Service Stream Ltd
desc: Service Stream Limited is a provider of essential network services to the telecommunications, utility and transport sectors. It designs, constructs, operates and maintains critical infrastructure networks. Its segments include Telecommunications, Utilities, and Transport. The Telecommunications segment offers a range of operations, maintenance, installation, design and construction services to the owners of fixed-line and wireless telecommunication networks in Australia. The Utilities segment offers a range of operations, maintenance, design and construction services to gas, water and electricity network owners, industrial asset owners and other customers in Australia. Service capabilities include asset maintenance, engineering, design and construction of network assets. The Transport segment offers long-term operational support and maintenance services to public and private road and tunnel asset owners. Service capabilities include road network maintenance and control room operations.

name: TPG Telecom Ltd
desc: TPG Telecom Limited is an Australia-based telecommunications company. The Company owns and operates the Vodafone mobile network nationwide. It operates a number of mobile and internet brands including Vodafone, TPG, iiNet, Internode, Lebara and felix, providing consumers with a portfolio of fixed and mobile products in the Australian telecommunications market. Its segments include Consumer and Enterprise, Government and Wholesale. The Consumer segment provides telecommunications services to residential and small office/home office customers. The Enterprise, Government and Wholesale segment provides mobile services to corporations, government and wholesale customers. It also provides fixed services to small-sized enterprise customers. Its subsidiaries include Vodafone Hutchison Spectrum Pty Limited, H3GA Properties (No. 3) Pty Limited, Vodafone Foundation Australia Pty Limited, Vodafone Australia Pty Limited, Mobile JV Pty Limited and AAPT Limited.

name: Waypoint REIT Ltd
desc: Waypoint REIT Limited is an Australia-based real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns fuel and convenience retail properties with a portfolio of networks across all Australian states and mainland territories. The Company's investment objective is to maximize the long-term income and capital returns from its ownership of the portfolio for the benefit of all security holders. Its portfolio is classified into four segments: Capital Cities, Other Metro, Highway, and Regional. Its Capital Cities assets are located in the Greater Capital City Statistical Areas of Australia's eight states and territories. Its Regional portfolio of assets is located in smaller regional cities and towns. The Company's properties in the portfolio are leased to Viva Energy Australia Pty Limited, with other tenants, including other fuel and convenience retail operators and non-fuel tenants. Its investment property portfolio comprised approximately 395 properties.

name: EVT Ltd
desc: EVT Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the entertainment, ventures and travel businesses. The Company's segments include Entertainment, Entertainment Germany, Hotels and Resorts, Thredbo Alpine Resort, and Property and Other Investments. The Entertainment segment includes cinema exhibition operations in Australia and New Zealand, technology equipment supply and servicing, and the State Theatre. The Entertainment Germany segment includes the cinema exhibition operations in Germany. Its entertainment business includes bars and restaurants, cinemas, outdoor cinemas, theatre, and wellness. The Hotels and Resorts segment includes the ownership, operation and management of hotels in Australia, New Zealand and Singapore. The Thredbo Alpine Resort segment includes all the operations of the resort including property development activities. The Property and Other Investments segment includes property rental, investment properties and other investments.

name: ARB Corporation Ltd
desc: ARB Corporation Limited is an Australia-based company, which designs, manufactures, distributes and sells motor vehicle accessories and light metal engineering works. Its product range includes a host of different accessories, from vehicle specific applications to a range of accessories, which are suitable for vehicles. Its products include earth camper; bull bars; side rails and side steps; rear protection, towing and wheel carriers; canopies; UTE lids and tub accessories; roof racks, cross bars and carriers; Old Man Emu 4X4 Suspension; Linx; driving lights; air compressors and tire accessories; air lockers; winches; recovery equipment; recovery points; under vehicle protection; fuel tanks and fuel storage; drawers and cargo solutions; slide kitchen; portable fridge freezers; tents, swags and awnings; camping and touring accessories; UHF radios, GPS and reverse cameras; safari snorkels; dual battery and solar systems; general accessories; interior protection, and merchandise.

name: Arena Reit No 1
desc: Arena REIT No. 1 is an internally managed real estate investment trust. It develops, owns, and manages social infrastructure properties. Its portfolio of social infrastructure properties is leased to a diversified tenant base in the growing childcare and healthcare sectors. Its investment objective is to deliver an attractive and predictable distribution to investors, with earnings growth prospects over the medium to long term. It favors long-term triple net leases with its tenant partners. The nature of triple net leases allows its tenant partners operational control over the properties from which they operate. It invests in various sectors, such as early learning/childcare centers, healthcare, including medical centers, diagnostic facilities, hospitals, aged care and associated facilities, and education, including schools, colleges and universities and associated facilities. Its portfolio includes 295 social infrastructure properties, which accommodate essential community services.

name: Aussie Broadband Ltd
desc: Aussie Broadband Limited is an Australia-based operating as a national carrier of telecommunications and technology services in Australia, servicing residential, business, wholesale and enterprise and government customers. The Company provides a suite of data, voice, and managed solutions. The Company’s segments include Residential, Business, Wholesale, Enterprise and Government, and Symbio. The Residential segment provides telecommunications services to residential users. The Business segment provides telecommunications services to business users. The Wholesale segment provides telecommunication services to third-party resellers. The Enterprise and Government segment provides telecommunication services to large enterprises including those in the public sector. The Symbio segment provides telecommunication services to software companies, telecom providers and enterprise customers.

name: Austal Ltd
desc: Austal Limited is an Australia-based global shipbuilder and defense prime contractor designing, constructing and sustaining advanced commercial and defense vessels. The principal activities of the Company include the design, manufacture and support of high-performance vessels for commercial and defense customers. The Company operates through four segments: USA Shipbuilding, USA Support, Australasia Shipbuilding and Australasia Support. The USA Shipbuilding segment includes the USA manufactures high-performance defense vessels primarily for the US Navy and Coast Guard. The USA Support segment provides ongoing support and maintenance of Austal and non-Austal vessels to the US Navy, principally in the United States (USA) and other international jurisdictions. The Australasia Shipbuilding segment comprises Australia, Philippines and Vietnam shipbuilding operations. The Australasia Support segment comprises Australia and Trinidad and Tobago operations.

name: Generation Development Group Ltd
desc: Generation Development Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of life investment products within the Australian Life Insurance Sector, investment research, product rating and managed account solutions. The Company’s segments include Benefit Funds Management & Funds Administration (Generation Life), Research and Ratings (Lonsec) and Managed Accounts Business (Evidentia). The Benefit Funds Management & Funds Administration (Generation Life) segment specializes in the provision of investment-linked savings and retirement income solutions through benefit fund structures. The Research and Ratings (Lonsec) segment specializes in connecting financial advisers, fund managers and super funds with tools, data and insights. The Managed Accounts Business (Evidentia) segment specializes in the provision of discretionary managed account and portfolio implementation solutions to financial advisers.

name: Beach Energy Ltd
desc: Beach Energy Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration and production company. The Company has operations in South Australia, Victoria, Western Australia and New Zealand. In South Australia, it operates Cooper/Eromanga Basin, Moomba Carbon Capture & Storage (CCS), and Otway Basin South Australia. It operates Otway Basin Victoria Bass Basin, and Enterprise Project in Victoria. It operates Perth Basin in Western Australia. It operates Taranaki Basin in New Zealand. The Otway Basin Victoria is an onshore and offshore basin which extends approximately 500 kilometers from Cape Jaffa in South Australia to north-west Tasmania. The Company has around 33% ownership interest in the Moomba CCS Project, operated by its joint venture partner Santos. Its Perth Basin operations consist of the Waitsia project (operated by Mitsui E&P Australia) and Beharra Springs (operated by Beach Energy) projects. The Taranaki Basin is located along the west coast of the North Island in New Zealand.

name: Data#3 Ltd
desc: Data#3 Limited is an information technology (IT) services and solutions provider. It is focused on helping customers solve complex business challenges using technology solutions. The Company’s three reportable segments include: Software Solutions, Infrastructure Solutions and Services. Software Solutions segment provides software licensing, consumption sales along with consulting services. Infrastructure Solutions segment provides hardware and accompanying software licensing, vendor-branded maintenance services and other services. Services segment provides consulting services, project services, maintenance services, managed services, contracting services, software licensing and vendor-branded maintenance services. Its data and artificial intelligence (AI) include business analytics, customer management, internet of things (IoT) location-based analytics, and technology intelligence. Its connectivity includes IT-OT networking, software-defined networks, wireless networks, and SD-WAN.

name: Deep Yellow Ltd
desc: Deep Yellow Limited is an Australia-based uranium mining company. Its projects include the Namibian project portfolio comprises of Tumas Project, Omahola Projects, Nova joint venture (JV) Project, Yellow Dune JV Project, Mulga Rock Project, and Alligator River Project. The Tumas Project comprises a series of palaeochannel/calcrete-type uranium deposits. Omahola Project is located within the prospective Alaskite Alley corridor, within which uranium deposits, including Rossing, Husab, Etango and Valencia are located. The Nova joint venture (JV) Project includes two exclusive prospecting licenses (EPL) prospective for both basement and palaeochannel-type uranium mineralization. The Yellow Dune JV comprises one mineral deposit retention license (MDRL) covering a drilled-out uranium resource of the palaeochannel/calcrete-type at Aussinanis. The Mulga Rock consists of two separate mining areas over a total length of 30 kilometers.

name: Dicker Data Ltd
desc: Dicker Data Limited is an Australia-based company, which is locally owned and operated distributor of information and communications technology (ICT) hardware, software, cloud and Internet of things (IoT) solutions. It also distributes information technology (IT) hardware, software, cloud, access control, surveillance and emerging technology solutions for the corporate and commercial market. It provides a range of solutions, which include access and surveillance, accessories, backup and recovery, business applications, business monitors, cloud, components, data center, data management, desktops, gaming, Internet of Things (IoT), networking, notebooks, peripherals, printers, pro AV and displays, power solutions, remote working, scanners and mobility, security surveillance, uninterruptible power supply (UPS), workstations, storage, servers, and video conferencing. Its subsidiaries include Express Data Holdings Pty Ltd, Dicker Data Financial Services Pty Ltd, and Dicker Data GP Pty Ltd.

name: Fletcher Building Ltd
desc: Fletcher Building Limited is involved in the manufacturing and distribution of building materials and residential, commercial and infrastructure construction. Its Light Building Products division is a manufacturer, distributor and marketer of building products used in the residential, industrial and commercial markets in New Zealand and Australia. Businesses include plasterboard, laminates and panels, insulation, piping, steel and aluminum. Its Heavy Building Materials division includes its interests in the concrete and aggregates value chain, including extraction of aggregates, cement production, ready-mix concrete and concrete products. Its Distribution division consists of building and plumbing product distribution businesses in New Zealand. In New Zealand, its Residential and Development division's operations include the building and sale of residential homes and apartments, development and sale of commercial and residential land and management of retirement village assets.

name: Kingsgate Consolidated Ltd
desc: Kingsgate Consolidated Limited is a gold and silver producer and owner and operator of the Chatree Gold Mine in central Thailand and the Nueva Esperanza Gold-Silver Project, located in the highly endowed Maricunga Belt in northern Chile. The Chatree Gold Mine is located in central Thailand, approximately 280 kilometers (km) north of the capital of Bangkok and straddles the Phichit, Phetchabun and Phitsanulok provinces. Chatree is a large, low-grade, low sulphidation epithermal deposit, located in the highly prospective Loei-Phetchabun volcanic belt. Nueva Esperanza Gold-Silver is a prospective pre-feasibility stage gold and silver project comprising several deposits (Arqueros, Chimberos and Teterita) located in a high sulphidation epithermal system, and a number of prospective exploration targets. Nueva Esperanza is located in the prolific Maricunga Belt in the Atacama Region of Northern Chile, 140 km North-East of the city of Copiapo, a regional mining center.

name: Vulcan Energy Resources Ltd
desc: Vulcan Energy Resources Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in geothermal energy and lithium exploration and production. The Company’s segments include Germany, Other European (France and Italy) and Australia. The Germany segment is engaged in the supply of geothermal energy, exploration relating to the Zero Carbon Lithium Project and engineering services. The Other European segment is engaged in exploration relating to battery materials and geothermal lithium. The Australia segment is engaged in administration and corporate support services. Its products include Geothermal energy, Sustainable Lithium, and In-house sorbent: VULSORB. The Company’s Lionheart Project is located in the Upper Rhine Valley Brine Field bordering Germany and France, is the lithium resource in Europe and a tier-one lithium project globally. Its subsidiaries include Vulcan Energie Ressourcen GmbH, Vulcan Energy Europe Pty Limited, and Vulcan Energy Engineering GmbH, among others.

name: Lovisa Holdings Ltd
desc: Lovisa Holdings Limited is an Australia-based specialist fast fashion jewelry retailer. The Company and its subsidiaries are primarily involved in the retail sale of fashion jewelry and accessories. The Company is also focused on designing, developing, sourcing, and merchandising all its branded products. The Company develops, designs, sources and merchandises 100% of its Lovisa branded products. It offers a range of products, including earrings, necklaces, rings, body jewelry, and others. It offers a range of accessories, including hair clips, watches, jewelry boxes, belts, headbands, and others. The Company has over 1031 stores across over 50 markets globally, including Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Namibia, South Africa, France, Austria, Belgium, Germany, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Poland, Italy, Hungary, Romania, Switzerland, Canada, Mexico, the United States, the United Kingdom, and franchised stores in the Middle East and South America.

name: FireFly Metals Ltd
desc: FireFly Metals Ltd is an Australia-based copper-gold company focused on advancing the high-grade Green Bay Copper-Gold project in Newfoundland, Canada. The Green Bay copper-gold project is located in the Baie Verte district of north-east Newfoundland, Canada. The project consists of multiple assets, headlined by the Ming underground mine. It includes other projects like Little Deer Deposit, Tilt Cove Project, and others. The Company also holds a 90% interest in the Limestone Well Vanadium-Titanium Project in Western Australia. The Limestone Well vanadium tenements lie north along strike from the Neometalis-owned Barrambie titanium-vanadium deposit, approximately 90 kilometers (km) southeast of Meekatharra. The Little Deer complex is located 40km south of the Ming Mine and is a high-grade copper-rich VMS deposit. Its Tilt Cove project covers an area of 115 square kilometers on the eastern coastal volcano-sedimentary rocks of the Baie Verte peninsula.

name: Nick Scali Ltd
desc: Nick Scali Limited is an Australia-based company, which operates as a retailers and importers of furniture. The Company is engaged in the sourcing and retailing of household furniture and related accessories. Its sofas and armchairs collection include recliner sofa collections, leather sofa collections, fabric sofa collections, occasional armchairs, and others. Its living room collections include TV and entertainment units, coffee tables, side tables, console and hallway tables, and others. Its dining room collections include dining tables, dining chairs, and buffet tables and sideboards. Its bedroom collections include mattresses, bedframes, bedside tables, and dressers, among others. Its rugs and accessories collections include rugs and mirrors. The Company imports leather and fabric lounges as well as dining room and occasional furniture. The Company has stores located in New South Wales, Queensland, Victoria, Tasmania, South Australia, Western Australia, and others.

name: Premier Investments Ltd
desc: Premier Investments Limited is an Australia-based company, which operates a number of specialty retail fashion chains within the specialty retail fashion markets in Australia, New Zealand, Asia and Europe. It also has investments in listed securities and money market deposits. It operates through two business segments: investments and retail. The retail segment represents the financial performance of a number of specialty retail fashion chains. The investment segment represents investments in securities for both long- and short-term gains, dividend income and interest. It owns Australian retail brands, such as Peter Alexander and Smiggle. Smiggle is a children’s stationery brand. Smiggle operates over 300 standalone stores across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland. It also provides electrical consumer products. Its subsidiaries include Kimtara Investments Pty Ltd, Premfin Pty Ltd, Springdeep Investments Pty Ltd and others.

name: Regis Healthcare Ltd
desc: Regis Healthcare Limited is an Australia-based aged care operator. The Company provides services to more than 10,000 older Australians through residential aged care homes, home care service hubs, day therapy and day respite centers and retirement villages. Its residential care provides services, including aging-in-place, short stays and respite care, specialist dementia care, and palliative care. It offers a number of aged care service options for short stay, respite care as well as different levels of personal service and choice with its club services, reserve and classic packages to choose from at select homes. Its home care services include provision of services to support older people with complex care needs to live independently in their own homes. It owns and operates specialist retirement and independent living villages in Blackburn South (Victoria), Norwood (Tasmania) and Queensland (Brisbane, Cairns, Townsville, Crows Nest and Atherton).

name: Silex Systems Ltd
desc: Silex Systems Limited is a technology commercialization company, the primary asset of which is the SILEX laser enrichment technology (SILEX technology). It is focused on the commercialization of its SILEX laser-based enrichment technology for application to key global markets: uranium production and enrichment (nuclear power), silicon enrichment (silicon quantum computing) and medical isotope enrichment (new cancer therapies). Its segments include Silex Systems, Translucent and Silex USA. Its technology includes SILEX Laser Isotope Separation Technology, SILEX Uranium Enrichment Technology, Global Laser Enrichment and SILEX Quantum Silicon Production for Quantum Computing. SILEX technology has been under development for uranium enrichment jointly with licensee, Global Laser Enrichment LLC. It is focused on the development of additional commercial applications of SILEX technology, including the production of Quantum Silicon for the emerging technology of silicon-based quantum computing.

name: Iperionx Ltd
desc: IperionX Limited is a titanium metal and critical materials company that uses patented metal technologies to produce high performance titanium alloys, from titanium minerals or scrap titanium, at lower energy and carbon emissions. It is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of its mineral properties in the United States and the research, development, and commercialization of its associated metals technologies to support an integrated titanium processing operation. It holds a 100% interest in the Titan Project, covering more than 10,000 acres of mineral properties in Tennessee, United States, which consider prospective for critical minerals including titanium, rare earth elements, silica sand and zircon. Its titanium metal and critical minerals are essential for advanced United States industries including space, aerospace, defense, consumer electronics, hydrogen, electric vehicles and additive manufacturing.

name: Arafura Rare Earths Ltd
desc: Arafura Rare Earths Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in the production of rare earth products. The Company produces rare earth products from the Nolans Project. The Nolans Project consists of a mine, process plant, including beneficiation, extraction and separation plants, and related infrastructure to be constructed and located at the Nolans site, approximately 135 kilometers north of Alice Springs in Australia's Northern Territory. Its rare earth products are Neodymium-Praseodymium (NdPr) oxide, and Mixed middle-heavy rare earths (SEG/HRE) oxide. NdPr oxide is the Company's flagship product, which is used by magnet and magnet alloy customers. The Company’s primary products from the Nolans project are rare earths, which are used in catalytic converters in automobiles, consumer electronics, energy efficiency lighting, optics, alloys, advanced ceramics and permanent magnets that enable e-mobility and renewable energy applications.

name: Aspen Group Ltd
desc: Aspen Group Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in owning, operating and developing accommodation properties. It provides a spectrum of products and services to its customers within residential, lifestyle and park communities, under different lease types and terms. Its segments include Rentals and Development. The Rental segment includes leasing dwellings and land sites to tenants. The Development segment is creating and selling new Lifestyle dwellings (and leasing the associated land sites) and Residential land lots. The Company's properties are Lifestyle, Residential and Park. The Lifestyle Properties include Four Lanterns Estate, Sweetwater Grove, Alexndrina Cove, Mandurah, Sierra, Strathalbyn, and others. Its Residential Properties include Lindfield Apartments, Perth Portfolio, Perth Apartments, Cooks Hill, and others. The Park Properties include Tween Waters Merimbula, Barlings Beach, Koala Shores, and Darwin FreeSpirit, Coorong Quays, among others.

name: DigiCo Infrastructure REIT
desc: DigiCo Infrastructure REIT is an Australia-based company. The Company is a diversified owner, operator and developer of data centers, with a global portfolio and broad investment mandate across stabilized, value-add and development opportunities. The Company's portfolio consists of 13 data centers across key Australian and North American markets with 238-megawatt (MW) of planned information technology (IT) capacity, including 76MW of installed IT capacity and a 162 MW development pipeline.

name: Domino's Pizza Enterprises Ltd
desc: Domino's Pizza Enterprises Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the operation of retail food outlets and the operation of franchise services. The Company operates through three segments: Australia/New Zealand (ANZ), Europe and Asia. The Company's menu consists of Domino's Pizzas, including Premium Pizzas, Traditional Pizzas, Value Max Range, Value Range, Value Range Pizzas, Vegan Range, Make Your Own, Meltzz, Loaded fries, Pizza Pasta, Sides, Chicken, drinks, and Desserts. Its Sides include Savoury Sides and Chicken Sides. Its Loaded Fries include BBQ Meatlovers Loaded Fries, Firebreather Loaded Fries, Bacon & Cheese Loaded Fries, And Cheesy Loaded Fries. Its Pizza Pasta include Smokehouse Pork Belly Pasta, The Lot Pasta, Buffalo Chicken & Bacon Pasta, Simply Mac & Cheese Pasta, Simply Bacon Mac & Cheese Pasta. The Company Drinks include Malted Vanilla Thickshake, Chocolate Malt Thickshake, and Chocolate Malt Thickshake With Cream.

name: Elders Ltd
desc: Elders Limited is an Australia-based agribusiness company. The Company's business includes rural services, real estate, insurance and others. Its segments include Branch Network, Wholesale Products, Feed and Processing Services and Corporate Services and Other Costs. The Branch Network segment includes the provision of a range of products and services through a common distribution channel, including agricultural retail products, agency services, real estate services and financial services. The Wholesale Products segment includes the Australian Independent Rural Retailers (AIRR) business based in Shepparton, Victoria, supported by a network of eight warehouses to supply independent retail stores throughout Australia. The Feed and Processing Services segment includes Killara feedlot, a diversified business incorporating grain-fed beef distribution, grass-fattening operations, cow manure processing and irrigated feed crop production in Quirindi, New South Wales.

name: Gemlife Communities Group
desc: GemLife Communities Group is a developer, builder, owner, and operator with Australia's Land Lease Community sector. The Company provides premium resort-style living for homeowners aged 50 and over, designed to support an active and socially engaged lifestyle. It delivers master-planned residential communities to support a smooth transition for senior downsizers, with modern homes that are low-maintenance and well-equipped, together with recreational and leisure facilities to support community-oriented living. Its segment consists of Development, Community Operations, and Corporate. The Development segment develops the land and sells the home on behalf of the landowner. A deed of development exists between the developer and the landowner. The Community Operations segment operates the community, which involves the maintenance of the common areas, such as the clubhouse, managers' residence, gardening and landscaping.

name: GQG Partners Inc
desc: GQG Partners Inc., together with its subsidiaries, is a global boutique asset management firm focused on active equity portfolios. The Company manages assets for clients by using Global Equity, Emerging Markets Equity, International (non-United States) Equity, and the United States Equity strategies. These strategies include Global Concentrated, International, Global and the United States Value, and Global ADR sub-strategies, which are primarily differentiated by the geography of the domicile, operations, or future growth prospects of companies in the portfolios. The Company's subsidiary is GQG Partners LLC (GQG LLC). GQG LLC is an investment adviser, which provides investment advisory and asset management services to pooled investment vehicles; separately managed accounts for the United States and non-United States investors; mutual funds, and other structures, including pooled investment vehicles.

name: Graincorp Ltd
desc: GrainCorp Limited is engaged in the integrated grain and edible oils business with a presence in grain storage and handling business in East Coast Australia (ECA) and is an edible oil processor and oilseed crusher in Australia and New Zealand. It has created a global supply chain with infrastructure assets that store, process and facilitate the transportation of grains and edible oils. Its Agribusiness segment is a grain and oilseed storage and handling network located on the ECA with diversified international grain and oilseed origination and destination capabilities. The key commodities and products handled and traded by this segment include wheat, coarse grains (including barley, sorghum and corn), oilseeds, pulses and organics. The Nutrition & Energy segment includes integrated business comprising of edible oils crushing, processing, manufacturing, distribution and trading of animal fats, and used cooking oils and vegetable oils to supply products to food, feed and fuel customers.

name: Guzman Y Gomez Ltd
desc: Guzman Y Gomez Limited is an Australia-based quick service restaurant (QSR) company. The Company delivers clean, fresh, fully customizable and made-to-order Mexican-inspired food to guests through various sales channels. It operates through two operating segments, which include the Australia Segment and the US Segment. The Australia Segment comprises all restaurants operating in Australia, Singapore and Japan. This includes approximately 87 corporate and 150 franchise restaurants in Australia, 22 restaurants in Singapore and five restaurants in Japan. Both Singapore and Japan operate under master franchise arrangements. The US Segment includes the US corporate restaurants and associated administrative costs incurred in the US, including that of non-restaurant personnel based in the US. It also includes a share of sales arising from the establishment of a management agreement in relation to the Naperville restaurant.

name: Iress Ltd
desc: Iress Limited is a technology company providing software to the financial services industry. The Company provides software and services for the financial services industry. It operates across Asia-Pacific, the United Kingdom and Europe, Africa, and North America regions. Its Trading & Global Market Data segment provides comprehensive solutions to financial market participants, encompassing market data, trading, compliance, order management, portfolio, and related tools designed to enhance business efficiencies. Its APAC Wealth Management provides financial advice software and related tools to the advice industry in the Asia Pacific region. Its UK segment includes UK Wealth Management and Sourcing, which provides insurance and mortgage comparison tools to UK financial advisers. Its South Africa, Canada & Other segment includes Financial Markets businesses related tools to financial market participants in South Africa and Canada.

name: Judo Capital Holdings Ltd
desc: Judo Capital Holdings Limited is an Australia-based holding company of Judo Bank Pty Ltd (Judo Bank). It offers term deposits directly and through intermediaries to retail and wholesale customers, including individuals, charities, universities, government bodies, self-managed super funds (SMSFs), and corporates. All deposits are term deposits, with limited overlap between the small and medium enterprises (SMEs) lending customers and the deposit customer base. It provides business lending solutions to SMEs. Its key services include business loans, asset finance, lines of credit, residential mortgages (business loan customers), and bank guarantees. Its other subsidiaries include Judo Securitisation Warehouse Trust 2020 - 1, Judo Securitisation Trust 2020 - 2, Judo Securitisation Trust 1R, Judo Capital Holdings Limited Employee Share Trust, Judo Securitisation Trust 2022 - 1, Judo Securitisation Trust 2023 - 1, Judo Securitisation Trust 2023 - 2, and Judo Capital Markets Trust 2023 - 1.

name: Karoon Energy Ltd
desc: Karoon Energy Ltd. is an Australia-based international oil and gas exploration and production company with assets in Brazil, the United States and Australia. The Company has two key producing assets: the Bauna Project in the Santos Basin, Brazil and the Who Dat assets in the Gulf of Mexico, United States. Its 100% owned and operated Bauna Project (which comprises the Bauna, Piracaba and Patola oil fields) is located in the BM-S-40 production license in the southern Santos Basin, offshore Brazil. It also holds a 100% interest in the Neon oil field, located approximately 75 kilometers (km) northeast of Bauna. It also holds a 100% interest in the Goia field, located approximately 18 km southwest of Neon. It also has 100% interests in six blocks (S-M-974, S-M-1038, S-M-1484, S-M-1605, S-M-1358, S-M-1603) in the Santos Basin, offshore Brazil. The Who Dat producing assets comprise the Who Dat, Dome Patrol and Abilene oil and gas fields and associated infrastructure.

name: Maas Group Holdings Ltd
desc: Maas Group Holdings Limited is an industrial service and real estate business with diversified exposures across the property, civil, infrastructure, renewable energy and mining sectors. The Company’s Residential Real Estate segment develops, invests, builds, and sells residential land and housing. Its Commercial Real Estate segment includes commercial construction that builds and constructs commercial developments; commercial development and investment that delivers commercial property and industrial developments, and investing in commercial real estate. Its Civil, Construction and Hire segment includes civil construction, electrical services, plant hire and sales, and underground equipment hire and repair. The Manufacturing segment is engaged in the manufacturing, sales and distribution of underground construction and mining equipment and parts. The Construction Materials segment consists of quarries that supply quarry materials for construction projects; and crushing and screening.

name: Macmahon Holdings Ltd
desc: Macmahon Holdings Limited is engaged in offering the complete package of mining and civil infrastructure services throughout Australia and Southeast Asia. The Company is a diversified contractor with capabilities in surface and underground mining, mining support and civil infrastructure. The Company services resource companies across various commodity sectors. Its end-to-end mining services encompass mine development and materials delivery through to engineering, civil construction, onsite mining services, rehabilitation, site remediation, training, equipment maintenance and refurbishment services. Its segments include Mining and Civil Infrastructure. Its projects include King of the Hills Gold Mine, Greenbushes Lithium Mine, Telfer Gold Mine, Tropicana Gold Mine, Kalgoorlie Consolidated Gold Mine (KCGM), Byerwen Coking Coal Mine, Dawson South Metallurgical Coal Mine, Foxleigh Project, Batu Hijau Copper/Gold Mine, Langkawi Quarry, Martabe Gold Mine, Poboya Gold Mine, and others.

name: McMillan Shakespeare Ltd
desc: McMillan Shakespeare Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is a provider of salary packaging, novated leasing, disability plan management, support coordination, asset management and related financial products and services. Its segments include Group Remuneration Services, Asset Management Services, Plan and Support Services. The Group Remuneration Services provides administrative services in respect of salary packaging and facilitating motor vehicle novated leases for customers. It also provides ancillary services associated with motor vehicle novated lease products, including the provision of novated lease finance. The Asset Management Services provides financing and ancillary management services associated with motor vehicles, commercial vehicles and equipment with operations in Australia and New Zealand. The Plan and Support Services provides plan management and support coordination services to participants in the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS).

name: Nanosonics Ltd
desc: Nanosonics Limited is an Australia-based infection prevention company. The Company's principal activities include the manufacturing and distribution of the trophon ultrasound probe disinfector and its associated consumables and accessories. It is focused on the research, development, and commercialization of infection control and decontamination products and related technologies. Trophon technology includes high-frequency ultrasonic vibrations that generate a sonically activated hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) mist that kills bacteria, fungi, and viruses. Its products include trophon2, Nanosonics Auditpro, and trophon EPR. Its trophon2 includes AcuTrace radio frequency identification (RFID) technology, which enables digital record keeping and captures disinfection data. Nanosonics AuditPro is an automated digital system that combines clinician infection prevention decision making, with the Trophon 2 device infection control workflow data, and patient procedure information.

name: Nine Entertainment Co Holdings Ltd
desc: Nine Entertainment Co. Holdings Limited is an Australia-based media company. The Company is focused on providing brands spanning news, business and finance, lifestyle, entertainment and sport. The Company operates a multi-platform media network, engaging audiences across television, broadcast video on demand, digital and publishing, subscription video on demand and events. Its content includes news, sport and entertainment. The Company's segments include Streaming & Broadcast and Publishing. The Streaming & Broadcast segment includes free-to-air television activities, 9Now and the Stan subscription video on demand service. The Publishing segment includes Nine Digital (Nine.com.au and other digital activities) and Metropolitan Media (metropolitan news, sport, lifestyle and business media across various platforms). It also holds a digital outdoor media platform, with operations in Australia and New Zealand.

name: Nufarm Ltd
desc: Nufarm Limited is an Australia-based crop protection and seed technology company, which is engaged in the manufacture and sale of crop protection products and its proprietary seed technologies business. It operates two business lines: Crop Protection and Seed Technologies. The Crop Protection business deals in the manufacturing and selling of crop protection products used by farmers to protect crops from damage caused by weeds, pests and disease. It is managed by geographic segments: APAC (Australia, New Zealand and certain parts of Asia), Europe (United Kingdom, European Union, and certain other countries in Europe, Middle East and Africa) and North America (United States, Canada and Mexico). Seed Technologies business comprises the base seeds, bioenergy, omega-3 and seed treatment. platforms. Its omega-3 canola - the plant-based source of omega-3 for human nutrition and animal feed. Its carinata and energy cane are supplying sustainable biomass feed stocks for the biofuels industry.

legal_name: PMET RESOURCES INC CDI ORD NPV 10:1
desc: PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust is a mortgage real estate investment trust (REIT) that invests primarily in residential mortgage loans and mortgage-related assets. The Company's segments include credit sensitive strategies, interest rate sensitive strategies and correspondent production. The credit sensitive strategies segment represents its investment credit risk transfer (CRT) arrangements referencing loans from its own correspondent production and subordinate credit-linked mortgage-backed securities (MBS). The interest rate sensitive strategies segment represents its investments in mortgage servicing rights (MSRs), Agency and senior non-Agency MBS and collateralized mortgage obligations (CMOs) and the related interest rate hedging activities. The correspondent production segment represents its operations aimed at serving as an intermediary between lenders and the capital markets by purchasing, pooling and reselling newly originated prime credit quality loans directly.

name: PEXA Group Ltd
desc: PEXA Group Limited operates a digital property exchange business. The Company’s segments include Australia and International. The Australia segment comprises the Australian Electronic Lodgement Network (ELN) in Australia, across New South Wales, Victoria, Western Australia, South Australia, Queensland, the Australian Capital Territory, Tasmania and Northern Territory. The Australian business also supports customers and suppliers with a variety of workflow and transaction support tools and products, referred to as adjacency products. The International segment provides digitalized property registration and settlement, and related services, in overseas Torrens Title jurisdictions, initially in the United Kingdom (UK). Its Australia segment facilitates providing a secure online workspace through which the parties preparing a property transaction collaborate to prepare for settlement, increasing the transparency between all parties.

name: Qualitas Real Estate Income Fund
desc: Qualitas Real Estate Income Fund (the Trust) is an Australia-based registered managed investment scheme. The Trust seeks to invest in a portfolio of investments that provide unitholders with exposure to predominantly Australian secured real estate loans. The Trust's investment strategy is focused on providing monthly income and capital preservation by investing in a portfolio of investments that offers exposure to real estate loans secured by first and second mortgages, predominantly located in Australia. Amounts raised by the Trust are invested in the Qualitas Wholesale Real Estate Income Fund. The Trust's investment manager is QRI Manager Pty Ltd.

name: Siteminder Ltd
desc: SiteMinder Limited is an Australia-based it offers a commerce platform for accommodation providers. It has two core subscription offerings in the SiteMinder Platform (Platform) and Little Hotelier. The Platform supports accommodation providers with key tools to grow reservations through direct customer acquisition, distribution through global and regional travel channels, get insights on their performance and eliminate manual processes. Little Hotelier serves as an all-in-one technology solution for smaller accommodation providers by combining the Platform's capabilities with a property management system (PMS), which has been designed specifically for their needs, to assist them with front-desk and other business operational functions. Its solutions are designed to support accommodation providers of all types and sizes in managing every stage of their customer's journey. Its offices are in Bangkok, Barcelona, Berlin, Dallas, Galway, London, Sydney, Mexico City, Manila, and Pune.

name: Web Travel Group Ltd
desc: WEB Travel Group Limited is an Australia-based global business to business (B2B) travel distribution company. The Company connects travel sellers with travel buyers across all major global markets. WebBeds, its brand, is a global online marketplace for the travel trade, an intermediary connecting hotels and other travel service suppliers to a distribution network of travel buyers all over the world. WebBeds sources room inventory from worldwide hotels, then connects, aggregates and merchandises that inventory as bookable product in its platform, the WebBeds Global Marketplace, and distributes it to a global network of travel trade buyers, who sell to the traveling public. Global and regional hotel chains, resorts, transfer and sightseeing companies and more - can sell their products through WebBeds by connecting to a diversified global network of over 50,000 travel buyers across more than 39,000 locations. It also offers application programming interface connectivity.

name: Alpha HPA Ltd
desc: Alpha HPA Limited is an Australia-based specialty materials and technology company, focused on the delivery and operation of the HPA First and Alpha Sapphire Projects in Queensland. The Company specializes in producing ultra-high purity alumina (HPA) and related premium aluminum materials through its solvent extraction (SX) and refining technology. Its projects represent the commercialization of its aluminum purification and refining technology and the production of critical high purity aluminum materials for a range of growing high technology sectors, including semiconductors; lithium-ion batteries; direct lithium extraction; synthetic sapphire glass for sapphire optics, power-semiconductors, micro-LED technology, and technical ceramics and specialty catalysts. Its products include Ultra AAP, Ultra GAP, Ultra GAP-X, Ultra TAB, Ultra NAP, Ultra HPB, Ultra ALN, ALN_ACS, Ultra ATH, and Ultra SAPPHIRE. HPA First Project Stage 1 produces its full range of high purity aluminum materials.

name: Black Cat Syndicate Ltd
desc: Black Cat Syndicate Limited is an Australia-based gold producer with operating mines and processing facilities at two of its three 100% owned operations. The Company’s projects include Kal East Gold Operation (Kal East), Paulsens Gold Operation (Paulsens), Coyote Gold Project (Coyote), and Mt Clement Antimony Project. Kal East comprises approximately 650 square kilometers (km2) of highly prospective ground to the east of the mining center of Kalgoorlie, Western Australia. Paulsens comprises over 3,640 km2 of tenure located 180 kilometers (km) west of Paraburdoo in Western Australia. Coyote comprises over 645 km2, 5.5 grams per tonne (g/t) Au, gold projects, located in the Tanami region of Western Australia. Mt Clement is located over 30 km from the Paulsens Gold Operation with highest-grade antimony deposit in Australia. The Company 100% owns and operates the Lakewood gold processing facility, located over 6km east of Kalgoorlie.

name: Metals X Ltd
desc: Metals X Limited is a tin producer and holds a portfolio of assets from exploration to development. The Company's principal activities include investment in a joint venture company operating a tin mine in Australia and investments in companies undertaking exploration and development of tin, gold and base metals projects in Australia and Europe. The Company owns a 50% equity interest in the Renison Tin Operation (Renison) through its 50% stake in the Bluestone Mines Tasmania Joint Venture Pty Ltd. It comprises the Renison Tin Mine located 15km north-east of Zeehan on Tasmania's west coast. The tailings dams have a Probable Ore Reserve containing approximately 48.3 Metric tons of tin and 98.8 kilotons of copper. Its base metals portfolio is leveraged both by global Gross domestic product (GDP) growth and by the burgeoning technological advancement in batteries, in particular their application in the electric vehicle market.

name: Catapult Sports Ltd
desc: Catapult Sports Ltd, formerly Catapult Group International Ltd, is an Australia-based company that offers sports technology solutions working with top leagues, teams, and organizations. Its products are designed to optimize performance, avoid injury, and improve return to play. Its three main product verticals are: Performance & Health, Tactics & Coaching, and Media & Other. The Performance & Health is engaged in the design, development and supply of wearable technology and athlete monitoring software solutions to sports teams, athletes, and the prosumer market. Tactics & Coaching is engaged in the design, development and supply of video analysis, editing, and publishing software solutions to sports teams. Media & Other provides media licensing, athlete management and professional services to customers. The Company's solutions consist of athlete monitoring, video analysis, racing analysis, recruiting, and content licensing.

name: Clarity Pharmaceuticals Ltd
desc: Clarity Pharmaceuticals Ltd is an Australia-based clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company. The Company is focused on developing targeted copper theranostics based on its SAR Technology Platform. It is progressing clinical trials with its approximately three key products, SARTATE, SAR-bisPSMA, and SAR-Bombesin. Its lead product, SAR-bisPSMA, is progressing through over three clinical trials: one theranostic trial (SECuRE) and two Phase III diagnostic trials (CLARIFY and AMPLIFY). SARTATE is developed for diagnosing, staging, and treating cancers that express somatostatin receptor 2 (SSTR2). SAR-bisPSMA is developed for diagnosing, staging, and treating prostate cancer that expresses prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA). SAR-Bombesin is developed for identifying and selecting patients for subsequent treatment of cancers that express a specific receptor called the gastrin releasing peptide receptor (GRPr), including breast cancer and prostate cancer.

name: Collins Foods Ltd
desc: Collins Foods Limited is an Australia-based restaurant operator. The Company is involved in the operation, management and administration of restaurants in Australia and Europe. Its business is the management and operation of quick service restaurants, comprising the KFC and Taco Bell brands. It operates KFC and Taco Bell restaurants in Australia, Germany and the Netherlands. It supports Australian manufacturers and service providers and purchases Australian-made products. The Company operates approximately 290 KFC and 27 Taco Bell restaurants in Australia, 62 KFC restaurants in the Netherlands, and 17 KFC restaurants in Germany. It also operates over 14 restaurants in Queensland, nine restaurants in Victoria and four restaurants in Western Australia.

name: Credit Corp Group Ltd
desc: Credit Corp Group Limited is an Australia-based provider of responsible financial services to the credit-impaired consumer segment. The Company's segments include debt ledger purchasing (Australia and New Zealand), debt ledger purchasing (United States) and consumer lending (Australia, New Zealand and the United States). The debt ledger purchasing (Australia and New Zealand) segment purchases consumer debts at a discount to their face value from credit providers in Australia and New Zealand. This segment includes the contingent collection services business in Australia and New Zealand. The debt ledger purchasing (United States) segment purchases consumer debts at a discount to their face value from credit providers in the United States. The consumer lending (Australia, New Zealand and the United States) segment offers various consumer loan products focused on credit-impaired consumers. Its loan products are delivered under a portfolio of brands, including CarStart and Wallet Wizard.

name: DPM Metals Inc
desc: DPM Metals Inc., formerly Dundee Precious Metals Inc., is an international gold mining company engaged in the acquisition of mineral properties, exploration, development, mining and processing of precious metals. Its assets include Timok Gold Project, Tierras Chelopech Gold-Copper Mine, Loma Larga Gold-Copper Project, Coka Rakita Exploration, Ada Tepe Gold Mine, Tierras Coloradas Exploration, and Vares Operations. The Timok gold project is located in the eastern region of the Republic of Serbia. The Tierras Coloradas is an exploration activities progress with systematic ground magnetic and radiometric survey at Tierras Coloradas which is located in the province of Loja Ecuador. Vares is an underground silver operation located approximately 50 km north of Sarajevo, in the municipality of Vares in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Loma Larga is a high-quality underground development project which has a similar geology, mining method and processing flowsheet as its Chelopech mine in Bulgaria.

name: EBOS Group Ltd
desc: EBOS Group Limited is a marketer, wholesaler and distributor of healthcare, medical and pharmaceutical products. The Company is also the owner, product marketer and distributor of animal care brands. Its segments include Healthcare, Animal Care, and Corporate. The Healthcare segment includes sales of healthcare products in a range of sectors, through its own brands, retail healthcare, pharmacy, hospital and logistic services, and wholesale activities. The Animal Care segment includes sales of animal care products in a range of sectors, own manufactured and contract manufactured brands, retail, and wholesale activities. Its Community Pharmacy business includes Symbion, ProPharma, Pharmacy Wholesalers Russells, TerryWhite Chemmart, Good Price Pharmacy Warehouse, healthSAVE, Ventura Health, Minfos, DoseAid, Intellipharm, Endeavour Consumer Health, and Red Seal. Its contract logistics include Healthcare Logistics, Healthcare Logistics Clinical Trials and Clinect.

name: Amotiv Ltd
desc: Amotiv Limited owns a portfolio of companies specializing in providing automotive products and solutions that meet the needs of its customers worldwide. The Company’s divisions include 4WD Accessories and Trailering; Lighting, Power and Electrical; and Powertrain and Undercar. Its 4WD Accessories and Trailering division encompasses various brands, including AutoPacific Group (APG), Hayman Reese, CruiseMaster, ECB, Rola, Parkside, Trojan, Trail Boss, Kaymar, TriMotive, BestBars, Fully Equipped, Crown Canopy, X-Bar, and Christine Products. Its Lighting, Power and Electrical division is engaged in delivering advanced lighting, power, and electrical solutions. The division includes various brands, including Brown & Watson International (BWI), Projecta, Big Red Gear, Twisted Throttle, and Caravan Electrical Solutions. Its Powertrain and Undercar division encompasses various brands, including Ryco Filters, AA Gaskets, Infinitev, and Australian Clutch Services (ACS).

name: Hansen Technologies Ltd
desc: Hansen Technologies Limited is a global provider of software and services to the energy, utilities, communications and media industries. The Company is engaged in the development, integration and support and global support of billing and customer information systems. Its segments include Energy & Utilities and Communications & Media. The Energy & Utilities segment encompasses the sale of software and the provision of consulting services for Energy & Utilities customers that primarily operate in electricity, gas and water. The Communications & Media segment encompasses the sale of software and the provision of consulting services for Communications & Media customers that primarily operate in telecommunications and pay-TV. Its services include Software Product Services, Cloud and Hosting, Managed Services, and Data Protection. Its Software Product Services include Architecture Consulting, Solution Delivery, and Systems Integration, CIS Managed Services, Hansen Learning, Product Support.

name: HMC Capital Ltd
desc: HMC Capital Limited is an Australia-based diversified alternative asset manager focused on real estate, private equity, energy transition, healthscope, and digital infrastructure. Its segments include Real Estate, Private Credit, Private Equity, digital, and Corporate. Its Real Estate segment includes its HMC Capital managed HomeCo Daily Needs REIT, HealthCo Healthcare and Wellness REIT, HMC Wholesale Healthcare Fund and the Last Mile Logistics Fund. Its Private Equity segment comprises the HMC Capital Partners Fund I. Its Private Credit segment comprises commercial real estate and corporate credit fund management strategies. Its Digital Infrastructure segment comprises its digital infrastructure strategies, including HMC Capital managed fund, DigiCo Infrastructure REIT and StratCap. Corporate segment comprises capital solutions activities. It operates a private credit asset management platform over the medium-term spanning real estate, corporate, mezzanine, and infrastructure loans.

name: Inghams Group Ltd
desc: Inghams Group Limited is an Australia-based integrated poultry producer. The Company is focused on the production and sale of chicken and turkey products across its vertically integrated free-range, value enhanced, primary processed, further processed and by-product categories. In addition, the Company's stockfeed is produced primarily for internal use but also for the poultry and pig industries. The Company's operating segments are Poultry and Feed. Its geographic segments include Australia and New Zealand. The Company's Ingham’s brand offers a range of products including Ingham's Chicken Breast Nuggets Cheesy, Ingham's Turkey Mince, Ingham's Classic Turkey Breast Oven Roasted, Ingham's Frozen Turkey Buffe, Ingham's Fresh Turkey Necks, Turkey Tenders Lettuce Wraps, Ingham's Turkey Thigh Roast, Ingham's Family Chicken Nuggets Original, and Ingham's Ready To Roast Turkey Breast With Spiced Apple And Cranberry Stuffing, among others.

name: Integral Diagnostics Ltd
desc: Integral Diagnostics Limited is an Australia-based provider of medical imaging services across Australia and New Zealand. The principal activity of the Company is the provision of diagnostic imaging services. The Company operates over145 clinics in Australia and New Zealand through various brands, such as Lake Imaging, Capital Radiology, Future Medical Imaging Group (FMIG), The X-ray Group, Direct Radiology, Imaging @ Olympic Park, Lime Avenue Radiology, Imaging Queensland, South Coast Radiology, Radiology Tasmania, Apex Radiology, Capital Radiology, Fowler Simmons Radiology, Astra Radiology, Trinity MRI, SRG Radiology and Horizon Radiology, among others. Lake Imaging offers radiology services to patients throughout Geelong, Central and Western Victoria. Capital Radiology offers a full range of diagnostic imaging services including low-dose digital x-ray, ultrasound, low-dose CT, echocardiography, 3T MRI, mammography, bone densitometry (DEXA), and interventional radiology services.

name: IPH Ltd
desc: IPH Limited is an Australia-based company which provides intellectual property (IP) services. A network of member firms working throughout 26 IP jurisdictions, with clients in more than 25 countries. The Company provides services for protection, commercialization, enforcement and management of all forms of IP, including patents, trademarks and designs. It operates through three segments: Australian and New Zealand IP, Canada IP and Asia IP. In the Australian and New Zealand segments, it offers services related to the provision of filing, prosecution, enforcement and management of patents, designs, trademarks and other IP services in ANZ. In Canada, provision of filing, prosecution, enforcement and management of patents, designs, trademarks, and other IP services in Canada. Includes acquisitions in this financial year of Bereskin & Parr (B&P). In Asia, provision of filing, prosecution, enforcement and management of patents, designs, trademarks, and other IP services in Asia.

name: MA Financial Group Ltd
desc: MA Financial Group Limited is an Australia-based global alternative asset manager specializing in private credit, real estate, hospitality, operating assets and private equity and venture capital. It also manages traditional asset classes, including equities, bonds, and cash. It offers a range of non-bank residential lending solutions, including home loans and commercial loans for individual borrowers. The Company operates in three segments: Asset Management, Lending and Technology, and Corporate Advisory and Equities (CA&E). The Asset Management segment incorporates the provision of asset management services and principal co-investment and strategic investments. The Lending and Technology segment includes lending platforms for the provision of loan funding, residential mortgages and financial technology, including mortgage aggregation services. The Corporate Advisory and Equities segment provides corporate advice, underwriting, and institutional stockbroking services.

name: MyState Ltd
desc: MyState Limited provides banking, trustee, equipment finance and managed fund products and services through its subsidiaries MyState Bank Limited (MyState Bank), Auswide Bank Ltd (comprising Auswide Bank and Selfco) and TPT Wealth Limited (TPT Wealth). Its segments include MyState Bank, Auswide Bank (including Selfco), and Wealth Management. MyState Bank’s product offerings include lending, encompassing home loans, personal, overdraft, line of credit and commercial products, transactional savings accounts and fixed-term deposits and insurance products. Auswide Bank’s (including Selfco) product offerings include lending, encompassing home loans, personal, overdraft, line of credit and commercial products, transactional savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, insurance products, leasing and commercial hire purchases. The Wealth Management division is a provider of funds management and trustee services. It operates predominantly within Tasmania.

name: oOh!media Ltd
desc: oOh!media Limited is an Australia-based out-of-home (OOH) media company. The Company is engaged in offering advertisers the ability to create deep engagement between people and brands across diverse OOH location-based portfolios in Australia and New Zealand. It also invests in technology. Its portfolio includes large format digital and classic roadside screens; large and small format digital and classic signs located in retail precincts such as shopping centers; large and small format digital and classic signs in airport terminals, lounges and in-flight; digital and classic street furniture signs; digital and classic format advertising in public transport corridors, including rail, and digital and classic signs in high dwell time environments, such as universities and office buildings. It also provides advertising creative and printing services. It has a network of over 35,000 digital and static asset locations that include roadsides, airports, train stations, bus stops, and others.

name: Charter Hall Social Infrastructure REIT
desc: Charter Hall Social Infrastructure REIT (Trust) is an Australia-based real estate investment trust (REIT) that invests in social infrastructure properties. The Trust's property portfolio assets comprise directly held investment properties and indirectly held interests in investment properties held through joint ventures. Investment properties comprise investment interests in land and buildings held for long term rental yields, including properties that are under development. The Trust's social infrastructure portfolio includes approximately 328 properties. Its retail projects include Bateau Bay Square, Lake Macquarie Square, Rockdale Plaza, Wanneroo Central, and Currimundi Markets. The Trust invests in commercial property that includes office, industrial, retail, or social infrastructure property through a direct or unlisted property fund. The Trust is managed by Charter Hall Social Infrastructure Limited.

name: L1 Group Ltd
desc: L1 Group Ltd, formerly Platinum Asset Management Limited, is an Australia-based global independent investment manager. The Company is a provider of listed equities and alternative investment strategies. It seeks to deliver this through breed investment strategies and remaining fully aligned with its clients.

name: Pantoro Gold Ltd
desc: Pantoro Gold Limited, formerly Pantoro Limited, is an Australia-based gold producer. The Company is focused on its 100%-owned Norseman Gold Project in Australia. The Norseman Gold Project is located in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia, at the southern end of the highly productive Norseman-Wiluna greenstone belt. The project lies approximately 725 kilometers (km) east of Perth, 200 km south of Kalgoorlie, and 200 km north of Esperance. The project tenure of approximately 1,000 square kilometers (km2) covers nearly all the historic Norseman Gold province. The project has measured, indicated and inferred mineral resources of 4.87 million ounces. The Norseman Gold Project lies immediately adjacent to the Norseman township and is infrastructure-rich with office and workshop complexes, camp accommodation, site laboratory, 10MW power station, bore fields and a road network servicing all existing mineral resource areas already in place.

name: Pwr Holdings Ltd
desc: PWR Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company and its subsidiaries are involved in the design, prototyping, production, testing, validation and sales of advanced cooling products and solutions to the motorsports, automotive and industrial original equipment manufacturing (OEM), aerospace and defense, and automotive aftermarket sectors for domestic and international markets. It operates through two segments: PWR Performance Products and PWR C&R. The PWR Performance Products segment is engaged in designing and manufacturing high-end motorsports, OEM, aerospace and defense, and automotive aftermarket products for non-United States markets. The PWR C&R segment offers its products primarily for the United States market. Its products include tube and fin heat exchangers, bar and plate heat exchangers, liquid cold plates, micro matric heat exchangers, and others. Its performance aftermarket products include radiators, intercoolers, transmission oil coolers, and others.

name: Redox Ltd
desc: Redox Limited is a global chemical, ingredient and raw material distributor focused on specialty and commodity products. The Company is focused on a variety of markets, including food and beverage, personal care, human health, animal health and nutrition, crop production and protection, detergents, water treatment, surface coatings, plastics and foam, rubber, mining, oil and gas, metals, building and construction, textile and leather, and lubricants. In the food and beverage market, it focuses on antioxidants, proteins and fibers, acidity regulators, vitamins, sweeteners, and other products. In the personal care market, it focuses on solvents, sunscreen, haircare products, among others. In the detergent market, it focuses on activated carbon, acetone, ammonium sulphate, butanol, calcium chloride, and other products. In the water treatment market, it focuses on swimming pool salt, water softening salt and others. It markets a range of over 1000 specialty and commodity products.

name: Ricegrowers Ltd
legal_name: RICEGROWERS LIMITE NPV CLASS B NON-VOTING
desc: Ricegrowers Limited, doing business as The SunRice Group, is a rice food brand company. The Company's segments include Rice Pool, International Rice, Rice Food, Riviana Foods (Riviana), CopRice and Corporate. The Rice Pool segment is engaged in the receival, milling, marketing and distribution of Riverina rice, directly to customers across many channels. The International Rice segment is engaged in the purchasing (including from the Rice Pool), processing, manufacturing, marketing and distribution of bulk or branded rice products. The Rice Food segment is focused on importation, local manufacturing, marketing and distribution of value-added rice-based products, including snacks, ingredients and microwave products, both in domestic and global markets. The Riviana segment is focused on distribution of both imported and locally manufactured branded specialty gourmet and special occasion food products. The CopRice segment manufactures and distributes bulk stockfeed.

name: Ridley Corporation Ltd
desc: Ridley Corporation Limited is an Australia-based animal feed manufacturer. The Company operates through three segments: Bulk Stockfeeds, Packaged Feeds and Ingredients and Fertilizer.
